description: Adversaries may use credentials obtained from breach dumps of unrelated accounts to gain access to target accounts through credential stuffing, which is a specific application of the brute force technique. Instead of randomly guessing passwords, credential stuffing uses known username-password pairs from previous breaches, attempting to force account access across domains.
artifacts: multiple authentication attempts using known credentials from breach dumps
authentication attempts with username-password pairs across different accounts
SSH/FTP/SMB connection attempts using compromised credentials
patterned authentication behavior (known credentials, different users)
successful authentication using previously breached credentials
